observedNativeResultFromParent: 41 of 42 pass; AirframeGeometry fails clockwise normals, unit normals, UV handedness and outward canopy assertions.

rootCause.explanation: DU and DV were raw centered finite-difference displacements, not derivatives. Their cross product is scaled by 0.002 * 0.00002, so FVector::GetSafeNormal's squared-length tolerance of 1e-8 zeroed valid surface normals. Zero normals prevent AddTriangle from selecting winding, produce zero bitangents regardless of flip, and make canopy outward tests fail.

specificExamples.firstFuselageVertex: Finish 0 vertex 0: raw cross squared length approximately 1.73595754e-13, below 1e-8 despite a nondegenerate surface.
specificExamples.mainWingTipTrailingEdge: At U=1, V=0.5, raw DV squared length approximately 4.37740248e-9; even normalizing raw DU and DV separately leaves this direction zero.

rootCause.rejectedPartialFix: Normalizing raw displacement directions before crossing still leaves 62 zero normals and 93 failing triangle UV corners, including mirrored wing/tail trailing tips and propeller blades.
rootCause.originalHandednessAndWinding: Existing Side > 0 reversal and Unreal clockwise Cross(C-A,B-A) are correct. The failure is scale-dependent zero normals, not a sign convention requiring guesses or global winding reversal.

fix: Divide both centered finite differences by their full sampling intervals to form DU/DV derivatives.
Normalize derivative directions before Cross(VDirection,Tangent), then normalize the cross and retain the existing mirrored-side reversal.
Derive bFlipTangentY from Dot(Cross(Normal,Tangent),VDirection), preserving UV direction alignment on both cambered wings, caps, fin, canopy and rotor.
Retain all native assertions and thresholds. Add bounded per-section diagnostics for vertex normal length, triangle indices/area/winding dot, UV determinant, and triangle-corner tangent dots/flip.
Strengthen coverage with separate left/right upper-wing assertions and all upper canopy normals facing outward.
Preserve the parent's qualified DublinAircraftVisual::FGeometry declaration.
